# `scope_move`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Guider directional mount move or stop; the app sends ["none"] to cancel arm motion.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider dispatcher table, handler @0x7af10 (64-bit guider build; movement watcher CheckMoveThr @0x1f7be0, driver Motion slot +584, MotionTimed slot +600, 5000 ms wait), @0x7657c (32-bit build); static analysis of app 3.3.2, BaseDeviceViewModel.setArmCancel |

Guider mount-motion command. Registered in the guider dispatcher table; on 4700 it is reached through the imager method-not-found relay (mount-and-motion R1, R2). READ: params are positional or keyed: direction (north, south, east, west or none) and optional duration_sec (integer 1..9). The handler needs a connected mount (315) with motion capability (210). A missing or non-string direction gives 105 and an unknown word 209. none while the guider movement watcher runs a goto, home or horizon move commands motion NONE, waits up to about 5 s for the watcher to end, stops the watcher thread and replies 0; the cancelled worker then reports its own terminal event. Otherwise none follows the direction path with direction NONE: a stop command, or a timed NONE move when duration_sec is given. INFERRED: motion NONE is a controller stop. A compass direction while a goto, home or horizon move runs gives 203. Without duration_sec it starts continuous motion and replies 0 (a repeat of the last continuous direction is skipped). With duration_sec, a non-integer gives 104 and a value outside 1..9 gives 204; it then makes a timed move when the driver supports one, else continuous motion. A driver failure replies with the driver's error code. The app sends ["none"] from its arm-cancel control. Mount serial (firmware 9.31, READ): a rate command (:R2 to :R8) and :MT<dir>NN; needs mount firmware 1.1.9 or later.

Side effects: Commands mount motion or a stop through the driver. none during a goto, home or horizon move also stops the guider movement watcher, which then emits its terminal ScopeGoto, ScopeHome or ScopeMoveToHorizon event. READ; the physical stop is INFERRED.

Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"scope_move"`. [READ] |
| `params` | array\|object | no | - | Positional [direction, duration_sec] or keyed {direction, duration_sec}. direction is one of north, south, east, west, none (required; 105 if missing or not a string, 209 if unknown). duration_sec is an optional integer 1..9 (104 if not an integer, 204 if out of range); seconds INFERRED from the name. The app sends ["none"]. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 315 | No mount is connected | `mount is not connected` |
| 210 | The mount driver has no motion capability | `not supported` |
| 105 | direction missing or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 209 | direction is not one of north, south, east, west, none | `invalid value` |
| 203 | A compass direction while the movement watcher runs a goto, home or horizon move | `equipment is moving` |
| 104 | duration_sec present but not an integer | `expected int param` |
| 204 | duration_sec outside 1..9 | `out of limit` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

A driver motion failure replies with the driver's error code; those codes are not exhausted by this table.

## Example

Request, app-cancel - The form the app sends:

```json
{"id":91,"method":"scope_move","params":["none"]}
```

Request, timed-move - Timed move to the north (values invented):

```json
{"id":92,"method":"scope_move","params":{"direction":"north","duration_sec":3}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_move","result":0,"code":0,"id":91}
```
